title: 002 低调勋章003 名侦探封无
content_zh:
002 低调勋章
在即将出门的时候一个男子上前扶着外国女子走出酒吧，他们没有去停车场，而是沿着街道行走，最后拐进一条小巷，随即就传来若有若无的喘息声。
关雨悄然出现在两人旁边，只见两人疯狂的接吻，那男子的手已经按在那高耸的胸脯上面，两人身体紧紧的贴在了一起。
天助我也！
关雨冷冷一笑就熟练的将包裹，驾轻就熟！
他捅的是男子的脖子，那男子浑身一震，随即倒下，而女子也同样如此。
但关雨却傻眼了。
只见任务窗口弹出，上面居然写着：“2/10”
也就是说，刚刚他居然又干掉了一个人，他立即关闭窗口，在两人鼻息之间摸了摸，女的还有呼吸，但男的却已经挂了。
居然被电了一下就死了，难道这家伙的电抗是负数？
不过他翻出男子的钱包，总算知道怎么一回事，这家伙居然是岛国人，难怪长的那么像华夏人，害他吓了一大跳。
死岛国人不死华夏人，善哉善哉！
关雨心里默念，随即他就将钱包里的钱全抽出来然后又将钱包塞回男子身上，他发现这次杀人居然没多大的罪恶感，甚至连昨天那种颤抖的感觉都完全消失了。
不过这是好事，一回生二回熟嘛。
其实主要还是杀的太意外，所以才没多少感觉，他看了看外国女子，想了一下，就将电棒果断放到女子的太阳穴，猛的
杀了个疑是华夏人的男子，成功+1，而杀了一个外国女子，居然没反应，郁闷了。
他翻出女子的钱包才知道，这女子居然是华夏户籍……
靠，全天朝的人都想要往外跑，你一个老外居然还傻愣愣的往天朝里钻，这不是犯贱么？
关雨心里暗骂，却赶紧跑路，同时手里还捏着一块奇怪的勋章。
这次出手，他得到软妹币六千以及这奇怪的勋章！

这勋章是杀死那华夏户籍的外国女子后爆出来的装备，没错，爆装备了。
这让关雨小小的有点意外，但却又仿佛在意料之中，杀怪不爆装备，那是国产的垃圾游戏才会出现的情况！
不过当时他没仔细看勋章的属性，虽然那小巷挺偏僻的，但如果被人撞见还是大麻烦，所以他才赶紧跑路。
走到偏僻的地方，他才松了一口气，将那勋章拿出来，只见勋章在他眼里顿时出现一个窗口，上面是勋章的属性：
————————
低调勋章（勋章）
级别：F-
+10点力量
-50存在感
备注：九个人和你站在一起，无论怎么数，还是九个人！
————————
关雨看着这属性，心里顿时火热起来，没想到杀自己阵营的人居然也能爆装备，他心里甚至想要大开杀戒。
当然很快他就理智的将这个不道德的想法删除，看着勋章，他心里就有点郁闷了，该怎么佩戴呢？
不过在他想到佩戴两个字的时候，那勋章就骤然消失，他就感觉到一股力量涌进他的身体，力量增加了。
加十点力量，实际上已经非常的多，要知道他本身的力量也才十点而已，现在就等于他的力气增加了一倍。
握了一下拳头，关雨有种自己能够一口气砸死一头牛的错觉。
将防狼电棒和手套放回包裹，回到学校，关雨就思考起来，既然是按照国籍定阵营，那么未必要找外国人，找本国那些有外国国籍的人，似乎也是不错的主意。
而且这样的话，还能够扰乱警方的追查，让他们看不出自己的目的。
不过真要实施，这计划几乎没有任何的可能性，毕竟不会有谁会告诉你：“喂，我的国籍不是天朝，快来干掉我吧！”
能干掉一个岛国鬼子，这已经是意外中的意外了。

而且现在他最重要的是实验勋章的作用，低调勋章可不止增加力气，最重要的是那减少五十的存在感！
尤其是下面那句话，十个人怎么数数都是九个，难道这存在感的减少就相当于隐身？
如果这个能力掌握好的话，对于完成任务显然拥有巨大的优势。
第二天，关雨就少见的和舍友们一起起床，他发现他不出声的时候，大家仿佛都没有看到他一样，不过他说了一句‘早上好’之后，大家就仿佛感受到了他的存在，于是大家就能够和他交流。
他大概已经明白，低调勋章的作用，不过还需要继续试验，正好今天早上有课，他就走到教室，已经有不少同学来到，关雨不说话，就坐在角落，果然就连平时能说上话的同学在他身边经过都仿佛没有察觉到他一样。
因为他的存在感减少了五十，所以存在感比一般人要低，大家都下意识的忽略了他的存在。
上课的时候，点名也同样如此，老师点名的时候，点到他的名字，大家东张西望愣是没有发现他，直到他举手叫‘到’的时候，大家才将目光聚集到他的身上。
低调勋章，只有在低调的时候才能够发挥作用，如果你本身行为太过高调，存在感太过强烈，那么它的作用就被抵消了。
关雨心里暗暗的想着，虽然不是隐身，不过这个能力也不错，例如他如果在夜里穿着黑色的衣服，站在角落不动的话，估计所有人都不会发现他，这就已经和隐身有异曲同工之妙。
一天很快就过去，夜晚关雨就说要去网吧打工，宿舍里的同学也知道他夜晚要工作，并没有怀疑，虽然维克多的死已经在学校传开。
走出学校，来到一偏僻处换好衣服穿上黑色大衣，他慢慢走入黑夜。
依然是酒吧，不过这次他来的是不同的街，完全是不同的方向，不过他还是敏感的发现酒吧附近都有可疑的人，这些人虽然看上去很平常，但那眼神却不一样！
便衣警察！
一瞬间关雨脑海里就出现这么一个词，这些人恐怕就是传说中的便衣警察，显然连续死了三个人，已经引起警方的重视。
尤其是其中两个还是外籍男子，一个不好可能会引起外交事故！
所谓外交无小事，如果继续有老外死在本市的话，恐怕局长的屁股都要坐不稳，自然相当重视。
关雨心里有点小庆幸，还好他得到低调勋章，现在站在暗处，那些便衣此时就算目光在他身上扫过也会熟视无睹。
他就站在角落里面，夜的阴影成为他最完美的伪装，他就看着那几个便衣，一开始他还不肯定，直到一个醉醺醺的醉汉撞到其中一个便衣警察，关雨就看到他衣服下面的手铐！
“看来酒吧不能成为目标了，还有一个地方应该能撞见老外！”忽然他想到燕海市出名的金沙滩，那里出名美女多，老外多。
之前他觉得那里不是下手的好地方，不过现在有低调勋章，或许可以试一试，反正酒吧这一带恐怕已经没多少希望了。

去金沙滩的话，步行最少要一个小时，显然不可能步行过去，必须要借助交通工具。
计程车是关雨第一时间排除的道具，想了一下他就想到办法了，学校里面有租自行车，这个倒可以利用一下，毕竟每天自行车的借用量都不少。
回到学校，租了一辆自行车，关雨就绕了个圈，这才向金沙滩行驶而去。
力量的增加好处很明显，他的速度也稍微得到了加成，自行车踩的飞快。
十五分钟后，他就来到金沙滩附近，虽然已经快七点半，但这里依然灯火通明，不少小食摊阵阵飘香。
锁好自行车，关雨就在人群中走动，最后走到金沙滩，看着大海，关雨深深吸了一口气，随即开始寻找目标，很快他就发现了一个白人胖子，这胖子穿着一条花花短裤，手里拿着上衣，穿着人字拖走在沙滩上面，一个华夏的女子则走在他身侧，这女子长相一般般，上身穿着泳衣，下面则是一条薄纱裙子，黄色的内裤隐约可见。
身材不错，但脸蛋不行。
关雨忽然摇了摇头，这时候想这个干毛，赶紧悄悄的跟上，两人是用英语交谈，关雨虽然听得懂一部分，但有一些却听不懂。
归根到底还是关雨接触的太少，不过大概还是听明白了，简单来说就是，两人准备结婚，而女子的户籍也已经转到加拿大，现在在选日子，女子说自己父母这边亲戚很多，男的表示很欣喜……
关雨知道这是一对很普通的情侣，而且大喜将近，他忽然有点犹豫，杀吗？
他忽然有点自嘲，如果没有听到这些话，他完全可以狠下心来立即将两人干掉，但现在听到了，他却有点不忍心，这样做是不是太丧心病狂了。
虽然他想要活下去，为了活下去也可以不择手段，但真要昧着良心？
他悄悄的退走，看着两人渐渐走远，忽然瘫坐在沙堆里，他杀了三个人，第一次杀人是恐惧，第二次杀人是充满了兴奋，而现在他在即将准备下手的时候却开始自我反省。
蝼蚁尚且偷生，他显然还不可能做到淡然面对死亡，所以十个老外必须杀，虽然这不是他的本意，但为了生存，只能死道友不死贫道！
不过时间还长着，不急一时，现在离一个月时间还很宽裕，如果顺利的话，他只需要十天的时间就可以干掉十个老外，毕竟现在他有低调勋章这样的作弊利器，警察很难注意到他。
杀那维克多，他一点愧疚都没有，毕竟维克多确实该死，而那小岛国的男子，跑到咋们大华夏来泡妞，当然死有余辜，至于那外国妞，关雨只能说声抱歉，谁让你选谁不好，偏偏选了岛国男。
他却忘了，他开始的目标其实是外国妞，那岛国男才是无辜的。
接下来得好好的找找目标，最好是那些该死之人，至少现在没必要让自己良心难受。
content_en:
002 Low Profile Medal
When they were about to go out, a man stepped forward to help the foreign woman out of the bar. They did not go to the parking lot, but walked along the street, and finally turned into an alley, and then there was a faint sound of breathing.
Guan Yu quietly appeared next to the two of them, and saw the two of them kissing crazily. The man's hand was already on the towering chest, and the two bodies were pressed tightly together.
God help me!
Guan Yu smiled coldly and skillfully wrapped the package with ease!
He stabbed the man in the neck. The man was shocked and fell down immediately, and the same happened to the woman.
But Guan Yu was dumbfounded.
I saw the task window pop up, and it actually said: "2/10"
In other words, he actually killed another person just now. He immediately closed the window and touched between the breaths of the two people. The woman was still breathing, but the man was already dead.
He actually died after being shocked. Could it be that this guy's reactance was negative?
However, he dug out the man's wallet and finally figured out what was going on. This guy was actually from the island country. No wonder he looked so Chinese, which shocked him.
It's good that the people from the island country will not die from the Chinese people!
Guan Yu thought to himself, and then he took out all the money from his wallet and stuffed the wallet back into the man. He found that he didn't feel much guilt for this murder, and even the trembling feeling from yesterday had completely disappeared.
But this is a good thing. Once something happens, it will become familiar again.
In fact, the main reason was that the killing was too unexpected, so he didn't feel much. He looked at the foreign woman, thought for a moment, then decisively put the electric baton on the woman's temple, and violently
I killed a man who was suspected to be Chinese and got +1 success, but I killed a foreign woman and there was no response, which made me depressed.
He dug out the woman's wallet and found out that the woman actually had a Chinese household registration...
Damn it, everyone in China wants to run out, but you, a foreigner, still stupidly sneak into China. Isn't this a bit mean?
Guan Yu cursed in his heart, but ran away quickly, holding a strange medal in his hand.
This time, he got 6,000 soft girl coins and this strange medal!
This medal is the equipment that was discovered after killing the foreign woman with Chinese registered permanent residence. Yes, the equipment was discovered.
This made Guan Yu Xiaoxiao a little surprised, but it seemed to be expected. Killing monsters without exploding equipment is a situation that only occurs in domestic garbage games!
However, he didn't look carefully at the attributes of the medal at that time. Although the alley was quite remote, it would still be a big problem if someone saw him, so he ran away quickly.
When he reached a remote place, he breathed a sigh of relief and took out the medal. A window suddenly appeared in his eyes, which showed the attributes of the medal:
————————
Medal of Low Profile (Medal)
Grade: F-
+10 points of strength
-50 presence
Note: Nine people are standing with you, no matter how you count, they are still nine people!
————————
Guan Yu looked at this attribute, and his heart suddenly became hot. He didn't expect that the people who killed his own camp could also explode their equipment. He even wanted to go on a killing spree.
Of course, he quickly deleted this immoral idea rationally. Looking at the medal, he felt a little depressed. How should he wear it?
But when he thought about wearing the two words, the medal suddenly disappeared, and he felt a surge of power pouring into his body, and his strength increased.
Adding ten points of strength is actually a lot. You must know that his own strength is only ten points. Now it is equivalent to doubling his strength.
After clenching his fist, Guan Yu had the illusion that he could kill a cow in one breath.
Putting the anti-wolf prod and gloves back into the package and returning to school, Guan Yu began to think about it. Since the camps were determined by nationality, it was not necessary to find foreigners. It seemed to be a good idea to find people with foreign nationalities in his own country.And in this case, it can also disrupt the police's pursuit and prevent them from seeing their purpose.
But if it is to be implemented, there is almost no possibility of this plan. After all, no one will tell you: "Hey, my nationality is not Chinese, come and kill me!"
Being able to kill an island country devil is already an unexpected surprise.
And now the most important thing for him is to experiment with the function of the medal. The low-key medal not only increases strength, but the most important thing is to reduce the sense of presence by fifty!
Especially the following sentence, no matter how many ten people are counted, there are nine. Is this reduction in presence equivalent to invisibility?
If this ability is mastered well, it will obviously have a huge advantage in completing tasks.
The next day, Guan Yu rarely got up with his roommates. He found that when he was silent, no one seemed to see him. But after he said "good morning", everyone seemed to feel his presence, so everyone was able to communicate with him.
He probably already understood the role of the low-key medal, but he still needed to continue experimenting. There happened to be a class this morning, so he walked to the classroom, and many classmates had already arrived. Guan Yu didn't say anything, just sitting in the corner. Sure enough, even the classmates who usually could talk to him didn't seem to notice him when they passed by him.
Because his sense of presence was reduced by fifty, his sense of presence was lower than that of ordinary people, and everyone subconsciously ignored his existence.
The same goes for roll call during class. When the teacher called his name, everyone looked around but didn't notice him. It wasn't until he raised his hand and called "arrive" that everyone focused their attention on him.
The low-key medal can only work when you are low-key. If your behavior is too high-profile and your presence is too strong, then its effect will be offset.
Guan Yu secretly thought that although he was not invisible, his ability was not bad. For example, if he wore black clothes and stood motionless in a corner at night, no one would notice him. This would be similar to invisibility.
The day passed quickly. At night, Guan Yu said that he was going to work in an Internet cafe. The classmates in the dormitory also knew that he had to work at night and had no suspicion, although Victor's death had spread in the school.
After walking out of school, he went to a remote place, changed his clothes and put on a black coat, and slowly walked into the night.
It was still a bar, but this time he came to a different street and in a completely different direction. However, he was still sensitive enough to find that there were suspicious people near the bar. Although these people looked ordinary, their eyes were different!
Undercover police!
In an instant, a word appeared in Guan Yu's mind. These people were probably the legendary plainclothes policemen. Apparently, three people died in a row, which had attracted the attention of the police.
Especially two of them are foreign men. If one of them is not good, it may cause a diplomatic accident!
The so-called diplomacy is no small matter. If foreigners continue to die in this city, I'm afraid the director's butt will be shaken, so he will naturally take it very seriously.
Guan Yu was a little happy in his heart. Fortunately, he had received the Medal of Low Profile. Now he was standing in the dark. Even if those plainclothes glanced at him, they would turn a blind eye.
He stood in the corner, the shadow of the night became his perfect disguise, and he looked at the plainclothes men. At first, he was not sure, until a drunken man bumped into one of the plainclothes policemen, and Guan Yu saw the handcuffs under his clothes!
"It seems that bars can no longer be a target. There is another place where we should meet foreigners!" Suddenly he thought of the famous Golden Beach in Yanhai City, where there are many famous beauties and many foreigners.
He thought it was not a good place to start before, but now that there is a low-key medal, he might be able to give it a try. Anyway, there is probably not much hope in the bar area.
To go to Golden Beach, it would take at least an hour to walk, which is obviously impossible.To walk there, you must use transportation.
Taxi was the first thing Guan Yu eliminated. After thinking about it for a while, he came up with a solution. There are bicycles for rent in the school, so you can make use of this. After all, there are a lot of bicycles borrowed every day.
After returning to school, Guan Yu rented a bicycle and drove around in a circle before heading towards the golden beach.
The benefits of the increase in strength are obvious, and his speed has also been slightly increased, making him ride the bike very fast.
Fifteen minutes later, he arrived near the Golden Beach. Although it was almost half past seven, the place was still brightly lit and many snack stalls were fragrant.
After locking up his bicycle, Guan Yu walked among the crowd, and finally walked to the golden beach. Looking at the sea, Guan Yu took a deep breath, and then began to look for his target. Soon he found a fat white man wearing a pair of flowery shorts, a top in his hand, and flip-flops walking on the beach. A Chinese woman was walking beside him. The woman was average-looking, wearing a swimsuit on her upper body, and a tulle skirt underneath, with yellow underwear vaguely visible.
She has a good figure, but her face is not.
Guan Yu suddenly shook his head. Thinking about this, he quickly followed quietly. The two were talking in English. Although Guan Yu could understand some of them, he couldn't understand some of them.
In the final analysis, I still have too little contact with Guan Yu, but I probably still understand. To put it simply, the two are planning to get married, and the woman’s household registration has been transferred to Canada. Now they are choosing a date. The woman said that her parents have many relatives, and the man expressed that he is very happy...
Guan Yu knew that this was a very ordinary couple, and that their wedding was about to happen. He suddenly hesitated, should he kill them?
He suddenly felt a little self-deprecating. If he hadn't heard these words, he could have made up his mind to kill the two of them immediately. But now that he heard it, he couldn't bear it. Isn't it too crazy to do so?
Although he wants to live and will do whatever it takes to survive, does he really want to ignore his conscience?
He retreated quietly, watched the two people walking away, and suddenly collapsed in the sand. He killed three people. The first killing was out of fear, the second killing was full of excitement, but now he started to reflect on himself when he was about to make the move.
Although the ant is still alive, it is obviously impossible for him to face death calmly, so ten foreigners must be killed. Although this is not his original intention, in order to survive, he can only die as a Taoist friend rather than a poor Taoist!
But time is still long, so don't rush for a while. There is still a month left. If everything goes well, he will only need ten days to kill ten foreigners. After all, now that he has a cheating weapon like a low-key medal, it will be difficult for the police to notice him.
He didn't feel guilty at all for killing Victor. After all, Victor really deserved to die. And the man from the small island country who came to our country to pick up girls certainly deserved his death. As for the foreign girl, Guan Yu could only say sorry. Who told you to choose who was not good, but you chose the man from the island country.
But he forgot that his initial target was actually a foreign girl, and the island man was the innocent one.
Next, you have to find a target, preferably those who deserve to die. At least now there is no need to make your conscience uncomfortable.
